scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf node_modules dist && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -p nest-lab -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -p nest-lab -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker down
scripts.infra:ps: docker compose -p nest-lab -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker ps
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -p nest-lab -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker logs -f --tail=100
